design.motif: A fantasy prop-maker's shield workshop surface: fine clean parchment grain, shallow diagonal leather-lacing channels and restrained hammered-metal edge impressions. A few broad asymmetrical heraldic construction folds only; no coat of arms, shield, weapons, runes, characters or text.

description.en: Fine clean parchment grain, shallow diagonal leather-lacing channels and restrained hammered-metal edge impressions.
description.zh: 洁净羊皮纸、斜向皮绳槽与浅锤纹金属压边承接盾牌道具的制作感，不另造徽章或武器主体。

design.rationale: The existing object, character or historical mark remains unchanged. Only a supporting working surface is interpreted from the product's purpose; no replacement Logo is generated.

description.en: Nostalgic 3D browser RPG with 20 classes, three realms, and local saves
description.zh: 怀旧风格的 3D 网页角色扮演游戏，提供 20 种职业、三大区域和本地存档。

purpose.en: Explore an RO-inspired single-player RPG in the browser, from character creation and quests to combat and local progress.
purpose.zh: 在浏览器中体验 RO 风格的单人 RPG，创建角色、探索地图、完成任务并保存进度。

rights: Owner-commissioned Azure OpenAI generated decoration under applicable provider terms. No third-party reference image or font was submitted. Existing Logo, font and product rights are unchanged. Do not describe raster output as handmade SVG or assert exclusive trademark rights.

contrast.method: WCAG relative luminance on every native RGBA pixel composited over actual Hexly normal/hover surfaces, before the left-edge mask. Text remains fully opaque.

publication: Export-time record. Upload receipts and the site release establish subsequent publication.
